description: Records how a campaign paid out to the user: paid in full, paid less than expected, still waiting, denied, or ghosted, with an optional amount and note. One report per account per campaign, the latest replacing the earlier one. Once four or more accounts have reported on a campaign, its counts show as payout_record on clipping_campaign_details, rank_clipping_campaigns and the campaign's heistclips page; below that only the number of reports shows.

amount_usd.description: What was paid, in US dollars, if anything

campaign_id.description: The campaign's id (from rank_clipping_campaigns, plan_my_clips or my_tracked_clips); an ended campaign's id works too

note.description: The user's own words, up to 280 characters

name: report_payout
title: Report whether a campaign paid the user
